mobbin:55855f6e-97e0-4984-9bae-f11cb21e6.summary: In Account Settings, the user reads the fixed Monday schedule for the analytics email, switches it on for one profile, and sees a confirmation.
steps: Account Settings: Analytics Email Report section at bottom
Fixed Monday PT schedule, Enable All, per-profile switch off
Switch on; success message says weekly report enabled for profile
steal: The schedule is fixed ('Emails are sent each Monday in the late afternoon (Pacific Time)'), so the only choice is on or off (screens 1 to 2).
A switch per profile, plus 'Enable All' and 'Disable All', pauses the email without losing the settings (screens 1 to 2).
The confirmation names the profile and repeats when the email goes out (screen 3).
avoid: The digest is buried in Account Settings, far from Analytics; for deans, the subscribe option belongs on the report itself (screen 1).
mobbin:55855f6e-97e0-4984-9bae-f11cb21e6.fit: Reports: the simplest weekly or monthly newsletter for deans, with one default schedule and a pause switch instead of a report builder.

mobbin:a56091b1-7e85-4b1b-a790-7e7ccbea9.summary: From the analytics overview, the user creates a shareable performance report, waits for its unique link, sets it to update automatically, and copies the public link.
steps: Overview: Share Performance Report button and Export CSV
Report settings: public URL, auto-update 24h, Enable, industry comparison
steal: A public report link with 'Copy Link' and a view count lets people see the report without an Essentials account (screens 4 to 5).
'Update Report Automatically' every 24 hours keeps the link current instead of a one-off export (screen 4).
An 'Enable Report' switch turns the report off without losing its settings (screen 4).
Sharing starts from the overview, next to the headline numbers, not from the settings (screen 1).
mobbin:a56091b1-7e85-4b1b-a790-7e7ccbea9.fit: Reports: a report pack for deans or accreditation, shared by link without accounts. Automatic refresh comes close to a scheduled digest, and the industry comparison hints at benchmarks without a builder.
